'''Dolan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the war ended, he didn't believe that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] betrayed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and went on to join [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Fy-Tor-Ana]] and [[The Eleven]]. In order to protect the resistance, Dolan [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and helped Solace to hide a group of refugees. However, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] who been hired to hunt down resistance leaders and traitors.
